title: Mine Was Damaged When I Got It!
text: Mine Was Damaged When I Got It!. Nice looking baker and I would have given it a much higher rating if one of the handles wasn't broken when it was shipped to me.

product_metadata.title: BIA Cordon Bleu Wavy 3-Quart Rectangle Baker, Red
features: Microwave safe, dishwasher safe, oven safe
description: Established in 1952, BIA Cordon Bleu is a leading manufacturer of porcelain and stoneware serving accessories, bakeware and dinnerware. With classic and contemporary shapes, as well as uniques glazes, hand painted patterns and designs, BIA Cordon Bleu continues the tradition of providing timeless, quality merchandise at affordable prices. The Wavy Collection from BIA Cordon Bleu adds a bit of fun and contemporary feel to your bakeware and tabletop accessories. These Wavy Collection Rectangle Baker pieces are a wonderful addition to any kitchen.There will always be some slight variation in ceramic products (a few 10ths of an inch variation is normal) this is due to how clay is fired in our kiln. Item should be measured from handle to handle.
